title: 第17章 王豹王头目第18章 杀王豹山阴功
slug: 开局黑狼拳简化后让我学狼叫
content_zh:
“桀桀桀，王红王堂主，没想到吧，我们圣教的教徒遍布四方。”李大龙踩在王红的背上，嘲讽笑道。
“阴，阴童教，你们都是阴童教的人……”王红脸色更加发白，身体颤抖。
“没错，王堂主，能将你的身体献祭给伟大的阴童大人，可真是你的福报啊。”
“饶，饶了我吧，我不想死，我愿意成为阴童教的教徒。”王红苦苦哀求道。
“桀桀，可惜，我阴童教不需要你这种不忠诚、不团结的人，废话说的太多了，你给我老实点吧。”
李大龙上前一脚踹断王红引以为傲的蛇精尖下巴，随后将其打晕过去。
“王虎，带着她回县城的圣教驻地，将其献祭给阴童大人。”
“是！”
“嘶嘶嘶……”
一旁，王红的宠物红蛇仰着脑袋，瞪着三角眼直面李大龙，一副威胁的样子。
“嘶啦！”
李大龙拔刀而过，速度极快，红色的脑袋就落地了。
“咬中了人你才叫毒蛇，咬不中，一根辣条而已。”
李大龙伸手将红蛇的蛇躯握住，当吃辣条一样吃了再去。
毒蛇的毒液都储存在脑袋处，蛇躯一般都是无毒的。
“吧唧吧唧……”
搞定了王红，接下来要伪装一下。
李大龙嘴角留着蛇血，眯眼笑道：
“王豹，你不是私底下练过黑狼拳吗，来，对我们都打一下，这里还有几名昏迷过去的血蛇堂帮众，全用黑狼拳解决掉。”
“是！”王豹笑眯眯上前，先是用黑狼拳解决掉血蛇堂帮众，随后又给了几人各一拳。

“这下王红堂主被掳走，生死未知，是黑狼帮所为，和我李某人又有何关系。”
戏做完，李大龙便和徐坤徐蔡二人以及王虎王豹，惊慌失措回到了矿场。
然后将黑狼帮埋伏的事告知，将一切都推到黑狼帮的头上。
加上徐坤徐蔡作证，所有人都信誓旦旦认为，黑狼帮刻意针对毒龙堂。
“堂主生死未卜，未免动乱被黑狼帮趁虚而入，所有血蛇堂的兄弟都暂时听李堂主的号令。”
徐坤徐蔡两人还在一旁加火，大有让血蛇堂并入毒龙堂的想法。
血蛇堂的人失去了堂主，没了分寸，只能听徐坤徐蔡两人的命令，暂时接受李大龙的指导。
李大龙一副“真情流露”的样子：“诸位都是我毒蛇帮的弟兄，我待你们如同一家人，你们放十个心好了。”
之后，李大龙将两堂人员合并，接着又安排头目，将人员分划了一番。
赵寒下午回来时，见到矿场上剑拔弩张，稍微打听了一下，不由无语。
哪有什么黑狼帮的伏兵啊，张龙赵虎，以及那三名捕蛇手，分明就是自己杀的。
但看这局面又不像假的，那个王红被黑狼帮生擒带走，李大龙也受了伤，似乎真有黑狼帮的帮众潜伏在附近进行猎杀。
“可我怎么没遇到过？”
“算了，关我什么事，老老实实把黑狼拳的熟练堆上去就成。”
“管你什么黑狼黑豹，毒蛇毒虫，我亦以一拳镇杀！”
赵寒又走了几步路，忽然身后有个精锐帮众喊道：
“赵寒，王头目找你有急事。”
“王头目，他找我什么事？”赵寒疑惑。
“你还不知道吧，刘刚刘头目，被划给血蛇堂了，现在毒龙堂是王虎和王豹两位头目负责。”
“啥，啥玩意……”赵寒脑子还有些跟不上。

刘刚去管理血蛇堂，王豹上位管理毒龙堂。
那自己呢？
“吃完饭后赶紧去吧，王豹王头目他的脾气你也知道，去晚了，小心你的屁……人头不保啊，桀桀桀……”
这帮众也是奇怪，说到最后，竟然奸笑起来，笑声听起来挺银荡的。
“知道了，多谢告知。”
content_en:
"Jie Jie Jie, Hall Master Wang Hong, you didn't expect that our holy sect has followers all over the place." Li Dalong stepped on Wang Hong's back and said with a mocking smile.
"Yin, Yin Tong Cult, you are all members of Yin Tong Cult..." Wang Hong's face turned even paler and her body trembled.
"That's right, Hall Master Wang, it is truly a blessing for you to be able to sacrifice your body to the great Lord Yin Tong."
"Spare me, spare me, I don't want to die, I am willing to become a member of the Yin Tong Cult." Wang Hong begged bitterly.
"Jie Jie, it's a pity that our Yin Tong Cult doesn't need a disloyal and ununited person like you. You talk too much nonsense. Please be more honest."
Li Dalong stepped forward and kicked Wang Hong's chin, which he was proud of, and then knocked him unconscious.
"Wang Hu, take her back to the Holy Cult station in the county and sacrifice her to Lord Yintong."
"Yes!"
"Hiss, hiss..."
On the side, Wang Hong's pet red snake raised its head and stared directly at Li Dalong with its triangular eyes, looking threatening.
"Hiss!"
Li Dalong drew his sword and passed by very fast, and the red head fell to the ground.
"You are called a poisonous snake if you bite someone. If you don't, it's just a spicy stick."
Li Dalong stretched out his hand to hold the body of the red snake and ate it like a spicy stick.
The venom of poisonous snakes is stored in the head, and the snake's body is generally non-venomous.
"Bah, bah, bah..."
After dealing with Wang Hong, the next step is to disguise herself.
There was snake blood on the corners of Li Dalong's mouth, and he smiled with squinted eyes:
"Wang Bao, haven't you practiced Black Wolf Fist in private? Come on, hit us all. There are still a few unconscious Blood Snake Hall gang members here, use Black Wolf Fist to deal with them all."
"Yes!" Wang Bao stepped forward with a smile, first used the Black Wolf Fist to kill the members of the Blood Snake Hall gang, and then punched several of them again.
"Now Hall Master Wang Hong has been kidnapped. His life and death are unknown. It was the work of the Black Wolf Gang. What does it have to do with me, Mr. Li?"
After the play was over, Li Dalong, Xu Kun, Xu Cai, Wang Hu and Wang Bao returned to the mine in panic.
Then he told the Black Wolf Gang about the ambush and put everything on the Black Wolf Gang.
Coupled with the testimony of Xu Kun and Xu Cai, everyone firmly believed that the Black Wolf Gang deliberately targeted Dulongtang.
"The life or death of the Hall Master is uncertain. It is inevitable that the Black Wolf Gang will take advantage of the unrest. All the brothers in the Blood Snake Hall will temporarily obey Hall Master Li's orders."
Xu Kun and Xu Cai were still adding fuel to the fire, and they had the idea of ​​merging the Blood Snake Hall into the Poison Dragon Hall.
The people of Blood Snake Hall lost their hall master and lost their sense of propriety. They could only listen to the orders of Xu Kun and Xu Cai and temporarily accept the guidance of Li Dalong.
Li Dalong looked like he was "revealing his true feelings": "You are all brothers of my Viper Gang. I treat you like a family member. Please just relax."
After that, Li Dalong merged the personnel of the two halls, and then arranged the leaders to divide the personnel.
When Zhao Han came back in the afternoon, he saw the tense situation in the mine. After asking about it a little, he couldn't help but be speechless.
There was no ambush by the Black Wolf Gang. Zhang Long, Zhao Hu, and the three snake catchers were clearly killed by themselves.
But it doesn’t look like this situation is fake. Wang Hong was captured and taken away alive by the Black Wolf Gang, and Li Dalong was also injured. It seems that there are really members of the Black Wolf Gang lurking nearby to hunt.
"But why haven't I encountered it before?"
"Forget it, it's none of my business, just increase your proficiency in Black Wolf Fist."
"It doesn't matter what black wolves, black panthers, poisonous snakes and insects you have, I will kill them all with one punch!"
Zhao Han walked a few more steps when suddenly an elite gang member behind him shouted:
"Zhao Han, Boss Wang has something urgent to do with you."
"Boss Wang, what does he want from me?" Zhao Han was confused.
"You still don't know, right? Leader Liu Gang Liu was assigned to the Blood Snake Hall. Now the two leaders of the Poison Dragon Hall, Wang Hu and Wang Bao, are in charge."
"What, what the hell..." Zhao Han still couldn't keep up.
Liu Gang went to manage the Blood Snake Hall, and Wang Bao took over to manage the Poison Dragon Hall.
What about yourself?
"After eatingGo quickly after dinner. You know the temper of King Bao Wang. You’re late, so be careful of your farts... Your life is at stake, Jie Jie Jie..."
This group of people was also surprised. At the end of the sentence, they actually laughed evilly, and the laughter sounded very silvery.
"I know, thanks for letting me know. "
